d:
"Akele Hai Chale Aao Jahan Ho" from the 1967 film Raaz is indeed one of the most romantic and timeless songs in Bollywood history! The song features the legendary Rajesh Khanna and Babita, with the beautiful voice of Mohammed Rafi that adds immense charm to the melody. It’s a soft, soulful track filled with love and longing, capturing the essence of romance in its simplest form.
